t: Napoleon's ally Louis X became Grand Duke Louis I in 1806 and later exchanged Westphalia for Rhenish Hesse with Mainz.
Its constitution of 1820 joined Lutheran Starkenburg and Upper Hesse with Catholic, French-law Rhenish Hesse.
Defeated with Austria in 1866, it joined the German Empire in 1871 and ended with the deposition of Ernest Louis in 1918.
dyk: After 1866 the grand duchy was split: its province of Upper Hesse had to join the North German Confederation, while Starkenburg and Rhenish Hesse stayed outside until 1871.
ev: Landgrave Louis X joins the Confederation of the Rhine as Grand Duke Louis I
Hesse exchanges Westphalia for Rhenish Hesse with Mainz and Worms
Louis I issues a constitution with a two-chamber parliament
Georg Büchner and Friedrich Ludwig Weidig distribute Der Hessische Landbote
Hesse is defeated with Austria and loses Hesse-Homburg to Prussia
The grand duchy becomes a member state of the German Empire
Ernest Louis founds the Darmstadt Artists' Colony
Ernest Louis is declared deposed on 9 November

f.founder: Louis I of Hesse (Landgrave Louis X)
